label: Actors
rubric: Box office draw (career + recent) · Critical prestige/awards · Current cultural buzz

entries.name: Leonardo DiCaprio
entries.rationale: Rare combination of billion-dollar box office pull and an Oscar-winning prestige résumé.

entries.name: Tom Hanks
entries.rationale: Two-time Best Actor winner and one of the most consistently bankable leads in film history.

entries.name: Tom Cruise
entries.rationale: Decades of blockbuster reliability, still opening films at the top of the box office.

entries.name: Robert De Niro
entries.rationale: Defining performances across multiple eras, with two Oscars and enormous critical weight.

entries.name: Denzel Washington
entries.rationale: Two Academy Awards plus a track record of carrying films on name alone.

entries.name: Al Pacino
entries.rationale: Anchored several of the most acclaimed films ever made; unmatched screen presence.

entries.name: Robert Downey Jr.
entries.rationale: Fronted the highest-grossing franchise in cinema and later added a competitive Oscar.

entries.name: Meryl Streep
entries.rationale: The most Oscar-nominated performer ever; the benchmark for acting prestige.

entries.name: Brad Pitt
entries.rationale: Long-running A-list star power plus acting and producing Academy Awards.

entries.name: Cate Blanchett
entries.rationale: Two Oscars and a reputation for elevating everything from art house to blockbuster.

entries.name: Scarlett Johansson
entries.rationale: One of the highest-grossing leads of all time with genuine critical range.

entries.name: Emma Stone
entries.rationale: Multiple Best Actress wins while staying a genuine box office draw.

entries.name: Morgan Freeman
entries.rationale: Instantly recognizable presence attached to a long list of classics.

entries.name: Anthony Hopkins
entries.rationale: Two Best Actor wins including one of cinema's most iconic villain performances.

entries.name: Margot Robbie
entries.rationale: Blockbuster lead and producer with a record-breaking hit and Oscar nominations.

entries.name: Timothée Chalamet
entries.rationale: The defining young leading man of his generation with major franchise backing.

entries.name: Jennifer Lawrence
entries.rationale: Youngest-ever multiple Oscar nominee and a proven franchise anchor.

entries.name: Joaquin Phoenix
entries.rationale: Best Actor winner with a reputation for total transformation into roles.

entries.name: Christian Bale
entries.rationale: Oscar winner known for extreme commitment plus a defining superhero run.

entries.name: Dwayne Johnson
entries.rationale: Among the highest-paid stars globally with enormous social reach, lighter on prestige.

entries.name: Will Smith
entries.rationale: Long stretch as the world's most bankable star, capped with a Best Actor win.

entries.name: Keanu Reeves
entries.rationale: Two era-defining franchises and off-the-charts goodwill with audiences.

entries.name: Samuel L. Jackson
entries.rationale: The highest-grossing actor by cumulative box office across an enormous filmography.

entries.name: Julia Roberts
entries.rationale: Defined the modern movie-star era and still commands top billing.

entries.name: Ryan Gosling
entries.rationale: Critical darling turned genuine box office force with real awards traction.

entries.name: Viola Davis
entries.rationale: One of the few performers with the full awards sweep across film, TV, and stage.

entries.name: Matt Damon
entries.rationale: Reliable leading man and Oscar-winning writer with a strong franchise record.

entries.name: Nicole Kidman
entries.rationale: Best Actress winner who moves fluidly between prestige film and premium TV.

entries.name: Natalie Portman
entries.rationale: Oscar winner with both blockbuster franchise credit and art-house credibility.

entries.name: Michelle Yeoh
entries.rationale: Decades of action stardom capped by a historic Best Actress win.

entries.name: Hugh Jackman
entries.rationale: Owns one of the most beloved comic book roles ever plus musical crossover appeal.

entries.name: Sandra Bullock
entries.rationale: Best Actress winner with an unusually broad hit record across genres.

entries.name: Charlize Theron
entries.rationale: Oscar winner who reinvented herself as a top-tier action lead.

entries.name: Zendaya
entries.rationale: Enormous current cultural momentum and franchise presence, still early in her film career.

entries.name: Angelina Jolie
entries.rationale: Global name recognition and an Oscar, though less active in leading roles recently.

entries.name: Anne Hathaway
entries.rationale: Oscar winner with sustained mainstream appeal and a strong comeback narrative.

entries.name: Ryan Reynolds
entries.rationale: Massive comedic franchise ownership and marketing savvy, lighter on awards.

entries.name: Chris Hemsworth
entries.rationale: Bankable franchise lead with real charisma but a thinner prestige résumé.

entries.name: Chris Evans
entries.rationale: Anchored a beloved superhero arc; still building outside the franchise.

entries.name: Florence Pugh
entries.rationale: Fast-rising with critical acclaim and major franchise roles already secured.

entries.name: Jake Gyllenhaal
entries.rationale: Consistently strong dramatic work with an Oscar nomination and cult favorites.

entries.name: Mahershala Ali
entries.rationale: Two Supporting Actor wins in a short span, a rare achievement.

entries.name: Idris Elba
entries.rationale: Commanding screen presence with big TV credibility, fewer outright film hits.

entries.name: Michael B. Jordan
entries.rationale: Franchise lead and director with strong critical goodwill still building.

entries.name: Ana de Armas
entries.rationale: Breakout international star with an Oscar nomination and rising visibility.

entries.name: Chris Pratt
entries.rationale: Attached to several billion-dollar franchises but low on critical prestige.

entries.name: Austin Butler
entries.rationale: Major breakout performance and awards attention; résumé still short.

entries.name: Jason Momoa
entries.rationale: Strong physical presence and franchise recognition, limited critical standing.

entries.name: Sydney Sweeney
entries.rationale: High current buzz and TV acclaim, still establishing a film track record.

entries.name: Gal Gadot
entries.rationale: Globally recognized franchise face with mixed critical reception outside it.
